context: A teen invites her father to a weekday matinee movie
purpose: Teach: 怪我/平日/うどん/パーセント/引く/映画館/食堂/出勤

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、平日に休み取れる日ってある？
lines.en: Dad, is there a weekday you can take off?
lines.style: Casual teen tone, slightly tentative as she floats the idea

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 来週の水曜なら出勤しなくていいけど、どうした？
lines.en: I don't have to go in next Wednesday, why?
lines.style: Warm fatherly curiosity, relaxed and open to suggestions

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実は観たい映画があって、平日の昼なら三十パーセント引くらしいの。
lines.en: Actually there's a film I want to see, weekday matinees are thirty percent off.
lines.style: Excited but trying to sound practical and budget-savvy

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: へえ、そんなに安くなるのか。どこの映画館？
lines.en: Wow, that cheap huh. Which theater?
lines.style: Pleasantly surprised dad voice, genuinely interested in the deal

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前のやつ。先月足を怪我してから外出してないでしょ、気分転換にどう？
lines.en: The one by the station. You haven't been out since you hurt your foot, fancy a change?
lines.style: Caring but teasing, nudging him gently out of the house

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ありがたいな。じゃあ帰りに地下の食堂でうどんでも食べて帰ろう。
lines.en: That's sweet of you. Let's grab udon at the basement diner on the way home.
lines.style: Touched fatherly warmth, suggesting a small treat to extend the outing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった、決まりね。チケット予約しとくから当日待ち合わせよろしく。
lines.en: Yes, it's a deal. I'll book the tickets, meet me there that day.
lines.style: Triumphant teen victory, already planning logistics in her head
